comparison.tradeoff: 解码约束Beam对明确top-k归一化后的路径分布累加质量，给目标近逐字事件的确定性LB与可能质量bank；它不证明随机数独立。反过来，直方图未拒绝均匀不能替代路径风险界。两者都须固定被审计的分布、协议与证据侧边界。

analysis.title: 样本检验的p值，与指定解码分布下的事件质量不是同一概率
analysis.body: LLM Stochasticity从有限样本检查输出是否偏离目标边缘分布，并用时序统计揭示周期或依赖；检验未拒绝不等于目标分布成立，更不证明独立。解码约束Beam固定每步top-k内的归一化概率，不把距离剪枝后剩余分支重归一化，再对可行完整路径求LB并把可能的丢弃质量计入bank。这是事件质量界，不是GoF p值。两者结合时应分别报告采样协议与风险事件，不能把p=1写成100%随机或100%提取概率。本地两组件都只验数值/协议，未加载LLM执行完整审计。

question.question: 均匀循环序列的卡方p=1，与解码约束Beam给出的近逐字风险LB=0.1，能否当作同一类概率比较？
question.answer: 不能。p=1表示该边缘频率检验没有拒绝均匀，确定性循环仍可能完全可预测；它不是输出事件概率。LB=0.1则是在明确top-k解码分布和目标距离事件下，已枚举路径的质量下界。两者的对象、假设和分母不同，时序独立性也不由任一数值自动保证。
question.example: 0,1,2,3循环1024次可有完美均匀直方图，但下一项由前一项确定。另一个模型的top-k概率树里枚举到目标邻域质量0.1，说明该事件至少有这部分质量，不说明模型采样是否使用独立随机源。

comparison.position: Tests a fixed number of completed external samples for marginal fit and temporal dependence. Chi-square/KS p-values are test evidence, not probabilities of output events.
comparison.tradeoff: Decoding-constrained beam search sums path mass under an explicitly top-k-renormalized distribution, providing a deterministic lower bound and a possible-mass bank for a near-verbatim event; it does not establish independent randomness. Conversely, a non-rejected histogram cannot replace a path-risk bound. Both require fixed distributions, protocols and evaluator boundaries.

analysis.title: A goodness-of-fit p-value is not event mass under a decoding distribution
analysis.body: LLM Stochasticity checks finite samples against target marginals and uses temporal statistics to expose cycles or dependence. Non-rejection establishes neither the null distribution nor independence. Decoding-constrained beam search fixes per-step top-k normalization, never renormalizes survivors after distance pruning, and sums feasible complete-path mass into a lower bound while retaining possible pruned mass in a bank. This is an event-mass bound, not a goodness-of-fit p-value. A combined evaluation must report sampling protocols and risk events separately: p=1 is neither 100% randomness nor 100% extraction probability. Both local components validate numerical/protocol properties without loading an LLM for a complete audit.

question.question: Can a uniform cycle's chi-square p-value of one be compared directly with a decoding-constrained extraction-risk lower bound of 0.1?
question.answer: No. The p-value reflects non-rejection of a marginal-frequency test; a deterministic cycle can still be fully predictable. It is not an output-event probability. The lower bound is enumerated path mass for a specified top-k decoding distribution and target-distance event. Objects, assumptions and denominators differ, and neither value establishes temporal independence.
question.example: A repeating 0,1,2,3 sequence can have a perfect 1,024-sample histogram while its next symbol is determined by the previous one. A separate model's probability tree may assign at least 0.1 mass to an enumerated target neighborhood, without establishing whether sampling uses an independent random source.

english.update: Compared sampling diagnostics with same-card decoding-probability bounds: goodness-of-fit p-values, temporal dependence and target-event mass remain distinct. Both are L1 components, not full LLM capability or security-audit evidence.

comparison.position: On-device RAG must limit both index storage and generation context/KV costs. ECG stores one multi-vector retrieval representation and projects it into compressed context for the same decoder, avoiding separate retrieval and compression representations.

analysis.title: ECG: shared representations for retrieval and context compression: intervention and evidence are different axes
analysis.body: No. ECG compresses external documents into shared semantic vectors. ADIndex shares attention candidate banks, then refines per query and adds newly visible tokens. Their support, fidelity and cost units differ. Compression genuinely consumes stored E_ret. Teacher distributions/relevance are detached while alpha and temperature remain differentiable. FKL sums answer-token KLs before batch averaging; margin uses declared hard negatives only. The paper specifies a large positive gate bias but no exact value: five is an explicit local convention. There is no pretrained decoder, index, special-token integration or full training pipeline.

comparison.position: 若benchmark已经被基座模型做得很好，合成数据是否真正传递新知识就难以区分。ContinuousBench定期生成或整理未见知识语料及相应QA，统一训练/evaluator设置，并与未经该语料训练的同一基座比较；关注高重复公共事实的utility，不要求DP模型记住单条私有记录。

comparison.position: Saturated benchmarks cannot reveal whether synthetic text transfers new knowledge. ContinuousBench periodically releases fresh corpora and derived QA, standardizes evaluator training and compares against the same unchanged base model. Utility centers on repeated facts rather than memorizing singleton private records.
comparison.tradeoff: No. Gain measures utility; epsilon/delta require a specified DP mechanism and accountant. Repeated-fact learning is not permission to memorize singleton records. Local code includes neither DP training/accounting nor the News judge.

analysis.title: ContinuousBench: measuring new capability from synthetic text: intervention and evidence are different axes
analysis.body: No. Gain measures utility; epsilon/delta require a specified DP mechanism and accountant. Repeated-fact learning is not permission to memorize singleton records. Local code includes neither DP training/accounting nor the News judge. The component independently implements the pinned cleaner/matcher semantics. Paired gains require identical IDs, questions, references and release revisions, with an explicit base arm. Test rows cannot select checkpoints. 'Flying and Normal' may contain both required types but is not the exact string 'Normal and Flying'. No model calls, large downloads, DP-SGD or automatic News judge are included.
